displayName: Catalog: the daily cost check has not run

documentation.content: The daily cost check (Cloud Run job catalog-cost-reconcile, scheduled at 06:00 UTC) wrote no cost rows in the last 30 hours, so the Cost card on the Ops page is out of date. The check runs every 10 minutes. Open Cloud Run jobs, catalog-cost-reconcile, and read the latest execution's logs (search for "cost reconcile" and "daily check failed"). Then check that the Cloud Scheduler job catalog-cost-reconcile exists and ran, and that catalog-worker@ still holds roles/monitoring.viewer and roles/run.viewer (bash infra/catalog-cost-reconcile.sh prints SKIP for each). A failed run leaves the earlier days as they were. Run it again by hand with: bash infra/catalog-cost-reconcile.sh run
